convert_hotpotqa_split: convert a HotpotQA formatted JSON file to a question list in SQuAD-compatible format
run_convert_script: run the convert_hotpot2questionlist_script with --split argument pointing to a HotpotQA JSON file
parse_hotpotqa_json: parse a HotpotQA JSON file and extract question text and question IDs
generate_question_list: generate a newline-separated question list file from HotpotQA data
extract_question_ids: extract question IDs from HotpotQA JSON entries and save to a text file
